claim: Observed source-target shifts are heterogeneous across clinical variables
required_v3_evidence: locked ontology; feature-level effect sizes; Wasserstein; PSI; missingness; patient-cluster uncertainty; alternative grouping sensitivity
historical_observation_status: V1/V2 prevalence and feature differences are hypothesis-generating only

claim: Observed shifts map to population measurement treatment and disease-mechanism causes
required_v3_evidence: multiple centers or external causal/measurement metadata; validated semantic mappings
historical_observation_status: No historical artifact identifies causal shift source

claim: Different feature tiers have different predictive transportability
required_v3_evidence: capacity-controlled source-only tier probes; source and target performance; patient-cluster uncertainty; size sensitivity
historical_observation_status: Historical SHAP and ablations are exploratory only
decision_consequence: If unsupported describe feature shift without transportability hierarchy

claim: Selective clinical alignment improves over dual no alignment
required_v3_evidence: D1/D2 versus C paired held-out contrasts across all locked seeds
historical_observation_status: V2 did not show stable outcome-specific CORAL benefit
decision_consequence: If unsupported no incremental selective-alignment claim

claim: Selective clinical alignment improves over architecture-matched global alignment
required_v3_evidence: D1/D2 versus G paired held-out contrasts across all locked seeds
historical_observation_status: V2 did not show stable superiority

claim: Clinical partitions outperform size-matched random partitions
required_v3_evidence: multiple locked random partitions; empirical random null; paired patient-cluster contrasts
historical_observation_status: Single historical random grouping is insufficient

claim: IDH and IH favor different transport strategies
required_v3_evidence: both partitions tested for both endpoints; prespecified endpoint-by-strategy contrast; multiplicity control
historical_observation_status: Historical outcome-specific mapping is hypothesis-generating only
decision_consequence: If unsupported remove outcome-specific mechanism claim

claim: Alignment reduces selected discrepancies while preserving outcome information
required_v3_evidence: latent distances; domain classifier; outcome probes; attribution stability; held-out prediction and calibration
historical_observation_status: V1 latent metrics were directionally inconsistent
decision_consequence: If unsupported representation language remains descriptive

claim: Supervised target updating improves over source-only deployment
required_v3_evidence: Model A versus source-only paired held-out contrasts and calibration
historical_observation_status: V1 supported updating but is historical exploratory for V3
decision_consequence: May support updating paper even if H2 fails

claim: The selected model improves clinically relevant net benefit
required_v3_evidence: clinically locked thresholds and alert action; untouched temporal/external cohort; DCA and alert burden with patient-cluster uncertainty
historical_observation_status: Historical thresholds were validation-derived and not clinically prespecified
